user.title: Radio Guard
user.description: Scheduled backups of your Zigbee and Z-Wave coordinators, stored under your Home Assistant config directory so they ride along in HA's own backups.

data.stale_hours: Warn when newest backup is older than (hours)
data.heartbeat_enabled: Publish MQTT heartbeat for an external watchdog

abort.already_configured: Radio Guard is already set up.

data.stale_hours: Warn when newest backup is older than (hours)
data.heartbeat_enabled: Publish MQTT heartbeat for an external watchdog

backup_now.name: Back up now
backup_now.description: Pull a fresh coordinator backup. Omit source to back up all enabled coordinators.

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Write a stored backup to the attached coordinator. Without confirm it only runs the pre-flight check and reports what would happen.

file.name: Backup file
file.description: Filename or path of the backup. Defaults to the newest.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Actually perform the restore. Leave off for a dry run.

force.name: Force
force.description: Proceed even if the pre-flight check reports a problem.

backup_failed.title: {source} backup failed
backup_failed.description: The most recent {source} coordinator backup failed: {error}. Check the logs and the upstream integration, then press the Back up now button.

backup_stale.title: {source} backup is stale
backup_stale.description: The newest {source} coordinator backup is {age} old. If the coordinator fails, the restore will be that far out of date. Press Back up now, or check why the schedule is not running.
